import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Total Sales by Product (Top Left)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars1, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group (Top Right)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[:len(age_sales)],
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(age_sales), startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Average Transaction by Size and Takeaway Status (Bottom Left)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
df['takeaway_status'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'})
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='size', columns='takeaway_status', 
                            aggfunc='mean').reindex(size_order)
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=[colors[0], colors[3]], width=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction ($)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Average Transaction by Size & Order Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Order Type', loc='upper left')
ax3.set_xticklabels(size_order, rotation=0)
# Add value labels on bars
for container in ax3.containers:
    ax3.bar_label(container, fmt='$%.2f', fontsize=8)

# 4. Sales Trend by Payment Method Over Time (Bottom Right)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['month'] = df['date'].dt.to_period('M').astype(str)
monthly_payment = df.groupby(['month', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
monthly_payment.plot(ax=ax4, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Month', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Monthly Sales Trend by Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Payment Method', loc='upper left', fontsize=8)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
